grain: account (one row per account_id in the firm's custody holdings axis UNION roster axis)
partition: date=YYYY-MM-DD (the silver partition date the dimension was built from)

columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the firm scope this row belongs to (the adapter's registry scope; a constant inside the one firm adapter, never typed in a consumer)

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the firm's own account key (the Black Diamond AccountID, the spine key); the custodian account number is a display family and is never a join key, so it is not carried

columns.name: household_id
columns.meaning: the HOUSEHOLD KEY: the relationship id the account belongs to. An account under several relationships takes the smallest id (deterministic) and carries the count in household_relationship_count. Null only with household_id_reason.

columns.name: household_id_reason
columns.meaning: why household_id is null; null when household_id is present

columns.name: household_relationship_count
columns.meaning: how many distinct non-sentinel relationships the account is a member of across the holdings and roster surfaces (0 when only the no-relationship sentinel is present)

columns.name: custodian
columns.meaning: the custodian of record from the roster surface; null with absent_fields where the account has no roster row

columns.name: account_type
columns.meaning: the firm's account type from the roster surface; null with absent_fields where the account has no roster row

columns.name: registration
columns.meaning: the account registration type from the roster surface; null with absent_fields where the account has no roster row

columns.name: client_id
columns.meaning: the client key (PRD brief Part V.1). NOT CARRIED by the Cottonwood silver in round 103: always null, listed in absent_fields. The owner name is not used as a key.

columns.name: tax_status
columns.meaning: tax status (brief Part V.1). NOT CARRIED by the Cottonwood silver in round 103: always null, listed in absent_fields.

columns.name: opened_date
columns.meaning: ISO date the account opened (brief Part V.1). NOT CARRIED by the Cottonwood silver in round 103: always null, listed in absent_fields.

columns.name: first_data_date
columns.meaning: ISO date of the account's first custody data (brief Part V.1). NOT COMPUTED in round 103 (needs the full custody history, not one silver partition): always null, listed in absent_fields.

columns.name: absent_fields
columns.meaning: the account-dimension fields this row carries null because the silver holds no value for the row, ';'-joined in contract order; never blank for a row whose any field is null

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: what this account's identity stands on (C-COVERAGE): FULL where the roster and the custody holdings both carry the account; UNCLASSIFIED_HOLDINGS where only the holdings carry it (no identity row); PARTIAL_HISTORY where only the roster does (no custody holdings yet)

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the dim_return_method row this dimension was built under (C-SHAPE: every table carries it). The dimension holds no return figure; the value is the adapter's method version

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: the PRD C-COVERAGE closed vocabulary restricted to the account grain (MISSING_HISTORY is topics only). This table emits three of its members; the other members are present for the same contract across firms. Covered by subtraction over the account universe: every account is in the roster AND the holdings (FULL), in the holdings only (UNCLASSIFIED_HOLDINGS) or in the roster only (PARTIAL_HISTORY); no account is in neither.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.household_id_reason: domain: why the household key is null. Covered by subtraction: an account with at least one non-sentinel relationship has a household_id; an account whose memberships are all the no-relationship sentinel (or carry none) has NO_RELATIONSHIP_SENTINEL. One member.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: one row per account_id, in both tables of the universe; relationship grain stays in the relationship dimension (C-SHAPE grain) and is summarised here only as household_relationship_count.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: one axis per field: coverage is the identity state of the account; absent_fields lists the null fields; the reason column explains the household key only. No field carries two intents.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: a null household_id is never a guess: it always carries household_id_reason. Moving the household key rule (smallest id) changes household_id only and no count; moving the count rule changes household_relationship_count only.
rule24_record.token_census: NO_RELATIONSHIP_SENTINEL: the one new enum member of this contract (household_id_reason). The other enum members are PRD C-COVERAGE members already ratified in the PRD.
rule24_record.token_census_method: comp-find --files --all 'NO_RELATIONSHIP_SENTINEL' (corpus scope all, the default; token matched as content)
rule24_record.token_census_finding: DENOMINATOR 79241 files scanned; 6 hits, all of them this round's own files (the adapter, its test, this contract) and one gitignored scratch backup; 0 hits anywhere else in the repo. The member is new and unused elsewhere. The CTO adjudicates whether it is admitted.
rule24_record.member_evidence: household_id from the Relationship ID of the holdings and roster surfaces; coverage from the presence of the account on each surface; absent_fields from the fields the silver does not carry (client_id, tax_status, opened_date, first_data_date, and the roster fields for an account with no roster row). Counts of each member are in the dry-run record, not in this file.

schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines joined by newline (no trailing newline), types as the pyarrow type name the adapter's ARROW_SCHEMA carries (string, int64). The check recomputes it from the adapter's ARROW_SCHEMA, so contract and adapter cannot drift. Method is the same as IRPT_DASHBD_ACCOUNT_RETURN_DAILY_CONTRACT.json.
firm_specific_columns: NONE. The Black Diamond column names (AccountID, Relationship ID, Custodian, Account Type, Account Registration Type) appear only inside the adapter; no firm-specific column is carried into this table.
served_day_rules: none: account_dim is a dimension, not a daily series; no served-day rule applies.
